The user wants to check the size of `bucket-events-5685`.
The `cloud_stat` tool failed due to token scope issues.
The observation suggested an alternative process: `api_post /api/tickets/TCK-366762/size-report`, and then poll `api_get` the `status_path` until the status is "done".
I have already called `api_post /api/tickets/TCK-366762/size-report` and received:
`{"job": "SR-fb6e81b9", "status": "queued: ready in 3 more status checks", "status_path": "/api/size-reports/SR-fb6e81b9"}`.
Now I need to call `api_get` on `/api/size-reports/SR-fb6e81b9` to check the status.
